subject: simsem output: Average Bias and Parameter Coverage

messages.author: 29468662cf83e2ce
messages.subject: simsem output: Average Bias and Parameter Coverage
parts:
Dear all,

I am simulating different scenarios for a latent growth model. Parameter estimates and standard errors are presented in a table, but I would like to have also the average bias and parameter coverage.
How can I get them?
I did some examples with a cfa model and I managed to have those results.

My syntax is:
Output1 <- sim(1000, SModel, n=50, generate=popModel, lavaanfun="growth", seed=53487)
summary(Output1)

Thanks to anyone who can help me.

Catarina
